title: Ball queue, round 4
instructions:
One question per frame: where is the game ball?
The loupe above shows the detector's best guess. Space: yes, that is the ball (frame done, next). Tab: show the next guess. Or click any guess on the frame (orange, or dashed: weaker).
No guess on the ball: ⇧-drag a tight box around it, then Enter. A guess on the ball but loose: drag its edges in the loupe, then Enter.
N no ball visible · S can't tell, skip · [ ] previous / next frame · scroll to zoom, F fit · U undo.
Game ball only: in hands, in the air, on the floor. Nothing in the crowd, on boards or on shorts.
